/chatbot_llm:
  ros__parameters:
    api_key: ''
    context_window_tokens: 4096

    first_request_timeout_sec: 75.0
    grounded_context_digest_enabled: false
    grounded_context_include_state_t0: false
    identity_reminder_every_n_turns: 6
    intent_detection_mode: llm_with_rules_fallback
    intent_max_tokens: 64
    intent_model: QuantTrio/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-AWQ
    intent_request_timeout_sec: 10.0
    knowledge_default_models: ''
    knowledge_default_patterns:
    - myself sees ?entity
    - ?entity rdf:type ?type
    - ?entity hasVisualCenterX ?center_x
    - ?entity hasVisualCenterY ?center_y
    - ?entity hasDetectionScore ?score
    - ?entity dbp:color ?object
    - ?entity dbp:name ?object
    - ?entity oro:isAt ?object
    - ?entity oro:isOn ?object
    - ?entity oro:contains ?object
    - ?entity foaf:knows ?object
    - ?entity ?predicate ?object
    knowledge_default_query_groups:
    - myself sees ?entity && ?entity rdf:type ?type
    - myself sees ?entity && ?entity hasVisualCenterX ?center_x && ?entity hasVisualCenterY
      ?center_y
    - myself sees ?entity && ?entity hasDetectionScore ?score
    - myself sees ?entity && ?entity dbp:color ?object
    - myself sees ?entity && ?entity dbp:name ?object
    - myself sees ?entity && ?entity oro:isAt ?object
    - myself sees ?entity && ?entity oro:isOn ?object
    - myself sees ?entity && ?entity oro:contains ?object
    - myself sees ?entity && ?entity foaf:knows ?object
    - myself sees ?entity && ?entity ?predicate ?object
    knowledge_default_vars:
    - ?entity
    - ?type
    - ?center_x
    - ?center_y
    - ?score
    - ?predicate
    - ?object
    knowledge_enabled: true
    knowledge_max_chars: 8000
    knowledge_max_results: 120
    knowledge_query_service_name: /kb/query
    knowledge_query_timeout_sec: 1.0
    max_history_messages: 20
    model: QuantTrio/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-AWQ
    persona_prompt_path: ''
    planner_mode_enabled: true
    planner_request_intent: planner_request
    planner_request_topic: /nao_orchestrator/planner_request
    planner_scene_summary_topic: /scene/summary
    preflight_attempts: 3
    preflight_enabled: true
    preflight_keepalive_interval_sec: 180.0
    preflight_realistic_enabled: true
    preflight_required: true
    preflight_timeout_sec: 60.0
    prompt_pack_path: ''
    request_timeout_sec: 60.0
    response_max_tokens: 192
    robot_name: NAO
    scene_memory_turns: 4
    server_url: http://10.7.138.215:8004/v1/chat/completions
    skill_catalog_max_chars: 3000
    skill_catalog_max_entries: 16
    skill_catalog_packages: communication_skills,nao_skills,kb_skills
    start_type_description_service: true
    temperature: 0.2
    think: false
    top_p: 0.9
    turn_pipeline_mode: response_first
    turn_trace_enabled: true
    turn_trace_topic: /chatbot_llm/turn_trace
    use_sim_time: false
    use_skill_catalog: true
